title: Deep learning prescreen identifies astragaloside II against dengue NS1 endothelial leakage
summary: A deep learning compound-target binding model using chemical fingerprints and protein sequences prescreened 177 natural compounds against NS1 of the four dengue serotypes, outperforming the DeepConv-DTI baseline on a BindingDB holdout and two independent sets. The selected compound, astragaloside II, counteracted NS1-induced endothelial hyperpermeability in HMEC-1 cells measured by trans-endothelial electrical resistance. Direct NS1 binding, infected cells and mechanism were not tested, so it is only a candidate.
ai_technology: Deep learning compound-target binding model with docking, prescreening natural compounds against dengue NS1
organization: National Science and Technology Development Agency; Siriraj Hospital; Mahidol University

evidence.tested: In vitro HMEC-1 trans-endothelial electrical resistance assays of astragaloside II against NS1.
evidence.unknown: Direct NS1 binding, mechanism, activity in infected cells and other endothelial models; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The model ranked compounds and nominated astragaloside II for testing.
